collection.description: A baby grabs a jeweler's necklace and scatters beads across the floor.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A baby grabs a jeweler's necklace during a visit and scatters beads across the floor.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The beads are gathered before anyone can swallow one; the jeweler redesigns the clasp.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The family and jeweler recover most beads, but one remains missing for years.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The jeweler creates a smooth, age-appropriate object instead of wearable small parts.
